MaxLineLength:ChangelogScreen.kt$"Advanced settings copy now reinforces that the key stays on-device and only powers optional carrier enrichment"
MaxLineLength:ChangelogScreen.kt$"After-call \"Was this spam?\" feedback notification now fires reliably — moved off the short-lived CallScreeningService handler onto a process-lifetime scope"

MaxLineLength:ChangelogScreen.kt$"All 5 remote lookup modules (ExternalLookup, UrlSafetyChecker, NumberTypeChecker, CommunityContributor, WebLookup) now wrap OkHttp execute() in .use { } — previously the Response was leaked on non-2xx paths"

MaxLineLength:ChangelogScreen.kt$"All UI spam checks (Lookup, Number Detail, Protection Test, Recent Calls) now use realtimeCall=false — no longer poison the campaign burst detector or pop caller-ID overlays"
MaxLineLength:ChangelogScreen.kt$"Blocked Log empty and filtered states now explain what happened and offer a one-tap recovery path back to all activity"
MaxLineLength:ChangelogScreen.kt$"Call screener role request wrapped in try-catch on all 3 launch sites (Dashboard, Settings, Onboarding) — prevents crash on OEM ROMs that remove ROLE_CALL_SCREENING"

MaxLineLength:ChangelogScreen.kt$"Contact whitelist lookups are now cached for 60 seconds — eliminates up to 4 redundant ContactsContract queries per incoming call on large contact lists (10–200 ms saved per call)"

MaxLineLength:ChangelogScreen.kt$"Dashboard \"today / this week / last week\" counts now roll forward on a one-minute time anchor — windows no longer freeze at app start and drift as the process stays alive"

MaxLineLength:ChangelogScreen.kt$"Database destructive migration restricted to legacy versions 1-4 only — future schema upgrades that lack explicit migrations now crash during development instead of silently wiping user data in production"

MaxLineLength:ChangelogScreen.kt$"Emergency contacts — whitelist entries can be flagged as emergency, bypassing blocklist, quiet hours, and aggressive mode with a distinct red badge in the Whitelist tab"
MaxLineLength:ChangelogScreen.kt$"Historical Call Log and SMS Inbox scans no longer poison the live campaign-burst detector or pop caller-ID overlays for calls that already happened"

MaxLineLength:ChangelogScreen.kt$"Hot-path microbenchmarks as unit tests enforce regression ceilings on WildcardRule.matches, CampaignDetector record/check, SpamMLScorer.score, and SpamHeuristics pure checks"
MaxLineLength:ChangelogScreen.kt$"Instrumented test suite: Compose UI tests for PremiumCard/SectionHeader/accentGlow, end-to-end CrashReporter IO, and the DashboardStatusModel state machine"

MaxLineLength:ChangelogScreen.kt$"Local crash reporter captures uncaught exceptions to filesDir/crashes/ — share the latest log via the new \"Share Last Crash Log\" Quick Link in More (no telemetry phoned home)"
MaxLineLength:ChangelogScreen.kt$"Log export cleanup now filters by filename prefix — no longer nukes in-flight blocklist exports that share the same cache directory"
MaxLineLength:ChangelogScreen.kt$"Lookup and Number Detail use rectangular status treatments for risk/type labels instead of default Material chip backdrops"
MaxLineLength:ChangelogScreen.kt$"Notifications honor the API 33+ POST_NOTIFICATIONS runtime permission instead of throwing SecurityException"
MaxLineLength:ChangelogScreen.kt$"One-tap FTC fraud report — any Number Detail screen now has a \"Report to FTC\" button that copies the number and opens reportfraud.ftc.gov"
MaxLineLength:ChangelogScreen.kt$"Report actions now use clearer flag semantics, with filter chips and action buttons brought into the same shape rhythm"
MaxLineLength:ChangelogScreen.kt$"Shared visual system tightened: modest 12dp surface radius, zero negative type tracking, and no selected navigation pill backdrop"

MaxLineLength:ChangelogScreen.kt$"Silent voicemail mode — blocked calls reach voicemail silently instead of hard-rejecting, so your phone doesn't ring. Off by default; opt-in from Settings → Detection"
